title: acronia lemniscifolia
intro: Acronia lemniscifolia, commonly known as the Philippine silver birch, is a plant species native to the Philippines. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Acronia lemniscifolia include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
